race.description: Sandy Miller Wtc Thanks You For 21 Yrs Hcp (58)
race.comment: Open race to close out the card. SHINING PROISIR (10) is close to breaking through after two consecutive placings, the latest coming when third over 1350m at Ipswich. Hoop Cartwright sticks in the irons and certainly has the talent to take care of this field. ED I AM (11) came home strongly last start to finish second, beaten 0.9 lengths, over 1350m at Ipswich when returning from a break. Should camp just off the leaders and is sure to be thereabouts. FLOP SHOT (12) resumes here but showed enough when last in work to warrant consideration in a race like this. Can play a role while fresh. WATER LAD (14) has been very consistent of late and is a must for the multiples.
